channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Porter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Porter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
NBABase: Draymond Green on Michael Porter Jr. admitting he lost motivation after his All-Star snub:

“Because he didn’t finish the year strong, people are just like ‘Oh man, he’s just out there playing on a bad team to make an All-Star game.’Now you’re going to have to play so much better… teams looking to sign him are going to hold this against him in the future.”

Draymond Green on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Sep 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sean Marks on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets GM Sean Marks on Michael Porter Jr extension talks:

“We’ll have those discussions. We’ve got time. There's no immediate hurry right now. We value him a lot. He had a terrific year.”

Sean Marks on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Jul 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on if Michael Porter Jr. could play this season:

“So, 2 or 3 weeks and then obviously there's a ramp up to go back to a competition level. We cannot predict but it'll be close. So we're going to go through these 2, 3 weeks, put the work in and then we'll see where we are.”

Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter, Mar 20, 2026. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter Jr. being motivated vs. the #Nuggets that traded him:

“If I'm in his shoes, I'll be very excited to play this game. I have no doubt in my mind he's going to go out & perform on both ends. So it's an exciting day for for all of us, especially for him.”

Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter, Jan 4, 2026. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter Jr:

“He's excited to be here; I'm excited to reunite w/ him. We have history together. I loved my time with Michael; he's going to bring a lot. His work ethic's very good. He's a pro, works really hard. That's going to be good for the young guys to see.”

Jordi Fernandez on Michael Porter, Jul 12, 2025. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr. blaming himself for the Timberwolves' loss:

“I couldn't disagree with Michael more. I don't want Michael putting the series loss on himself.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, May 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: LeBron James on Michael Porter
item.description:
LeBron James:

“Michael Porter is the one who kicked our ass. Remember we talking about like having luck to win a championship? Denver is a is a case for that. There's no way coming out of high school before the back surgery that Michael Porter would even be in Denver. This guy was a projected No. 1 pick in the draft, you know, and because of the back teams get alarmed and whatever the case. Because of that and he slid in the draft and he slid right to the perfect position.”

LeBron James on Michael Porter, May 8, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr:

“What he's doing has never been done before, from a medical standpoint.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Jan 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Full answer from Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr.’s spot in the starting lineup NOT being in jeopardy:

“I have zero doubt that Michael Porter is going to win a game for us.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Jun 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr:

“I have zero doubt that he's going to have a very big coming up here that's going to help us win this championship.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Michael Porter Jr, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Michael Porter
item.description:
Aaron Gordon on getting the DPOG chain:

“I think the defensive player of the game could have gone to Michael Porter too.”

Aaron Gordon on Michael Porter, Jun 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Michael Porter
item.description:
Jamal Murray on Michael Porter Jr:

“I don’t think he gets enough credit for how well he’s played though how many injuries he’s been through.”

Jamal Murray on Michael Porter, Jun 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“I think we’re past the point of praising Michael [Porter Jr.] for his defense every game.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter
item.description:
“I’m here to win a championship for Joker (Nikola Jokic).Joker’s here to win a championship for Jamal (Murray) and Michael Malone and Michael Porter. KCP, we’re looking to get him another one. I’m not doing this for myself. I’m doing it for the guys around me.”

Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter, Mar 8, 2023. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Michael Singer:Michael Malone on MPJ:

“I'm so proud of Michael. ... I'm on him a lot about his defense ... I want him to be the best version of Michael Porter. ... He's showed me that he cares.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Oct 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Michael Malone today on shot selection:

“Michael Porter made a contested mid-range two last night. The spacing was awful, the execution was awful and the shot went in. Poor possession. Poor shot. We can get better than that.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Oct 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter
item.description:
“But on the other side, what’s really easy is I know what Coach Malone likes. I have a feeling or a vision for the kind of guys, Nikola, Jamal or Michael would like to play with, and it just happens to be in line with my philosophy anyway.”

Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter, Jul 13, 2022. Source: DNVR.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Michael Porter Jr:

“It’s an ongoing thing, trying to figure out what’s going on…I’d still say that Michael’s out for the foreseeable future. We’re trying to take it one day at a time with him and see what the best way to approach getting him back healthy is.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Nov 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on MPJ’s status:

“Michael could be back in a week. It could be longer than that. When I say foreseeable future, I’m not really sure what that means.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Nov 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
“Flying around, defensively, rebounding the basketball. The constant message with Michael is ‘Don’t allow your not making shots to impact every other facet of your game,’ because if you allow that, then basically what you’re saying is that, ‘You’re just a specialist.’ … We have much bigger demands of Michael Porter than just being able to make shots.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Nov 4, 2021. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Michael Porter
item.description:
“I shared those opinions loudly not with just Michael—he’s not the only guy on our team that shares a similar stance. It’s something I don’t agree with, but it’s a very personal decision. It’s not something we can or would mandate.”

Tim Connelly on Michael Porter, Oct 16, 2021. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Michael Porter
item.description:
Connelly on MPJ contract:

“We’re looking to (extend him). Both the team and Michael can’t imagine him being elsewhere. Fingers crossed (it happens soon).”

Tim Connelly on Michael Porter, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone:

“I think Michael Porter has to be mentioned for the Most Improved Player in the NBA.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, May 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Michael Porter
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Michael Porter Jr.:

“Michael Porter is growing into his own player. I hear the comparisons, but he’s his own player.”

Kevin Durant on Michael Porter, May 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @Alex__Schiffer.

item.title: Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter
item.description:
“We were without two starters tonight -- no Gary Harris, no Michael Porter. I don't think we have been whole the whole year. JaMychal Green was out early, Michael Porter has been out with COVID, and Gary was not here due to personal reasons. I think that's one thing that will help us.”

Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter
item.description:
“I think (Nikola Jokic) and ‘Mal, Mike (Porter Jr.), everybody did a good job of just moving the ball, making it easy for us, making it easy for me, on the offensive end,”

Jerami Grant on Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter, Sep 27, 2020. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Michael Porter, Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Doc Rivers on how difficult it was assessing and passing on Michael Porter Jr. at 12 + 13 for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander + Jerome Robinson:

“Just the medical report, the red flag was so hot... it was a brutal pass because everyone knew his talent but it was more the injury concern.”

Doc Rivers on Michael Porter, Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter
item.description:
Tim Connelly on @MileHighSports:

“There’s been so much focus on Nikola’s body, I think Jamal looks fantastic. He’s really toned up. I think he looks quicker. He looks more explosive. Michael’s fully healthy. He was dealing with a pretty serious ankle injury (before the hiatus).”

Tim Connelly on Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter, Jul 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Michael Porter
item.description:
Michael Singer:Michael Malone, on his reaction to MPJ missing Rising Stars:

“If Michael Porter is not a rising star in the NBA, I don’t know what the hell a rising star is.”

Michael Malone on Michael Porter, Jan 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Michael Porter
item.description:
“You could see him, when had the lineup of me, Gary (Harris), Jamal (Murray), Paul (Millsap) and (Porter), and we were just moving and cutting, and he just didn’t know what to do. So we told him, ‘Whenever you’re standing, you’re wrong. Whatever you do, just move and that’s good.’”

Nikola Jokic on Michael Porter, Oct 3, 2019. Source: The Athletic.
